name: French Street Addresses
description: The number and its extension (bis, ter, a letter, a range), every type of voie La Poste uses and its abbreviations, names with particles, saints, accents, apostrophes and numbers in them, a street with no type, and the whole address in capitals. Original cases written for this corpus from La Poste's addressing guidance, described in our own words; the postcodes and communes are La Poste's base officielle (Licence Ouverte 2.0).
